_: fall (weather_fx.gd): how near the camera's target the rain and snow fall in full and where they're gone (rain_near, snow_near: [full up to, gone by], world units: the rig never comes under 6), a raindrop's width, length, alpha and the ring round the lens it falls in (rain_drop: fine soft lines, Manor Lords), its colour (rain_colour: a soft grey, never white), a flake's size, alpha and ring (snow_flake). The weather on the town (weather_fx.gd; the finesse catalogue's shared facts; Manor Lords, Foundation). The wind (direction and strength) and the wetness (0 dry .. 1 soaked) are each one fact, set by the weather the bridge rolls, published as the shader globals wind and wet and as WeatherFx.wind / WeatherFx.wet for the rest (fire spread, smoke, grass, banners, the townsfolk). on: the town's weather dressing (or --weather=v2 / --weather=off): roofs (snow.gdshader as an overlay on the towns' building batches, never on people): wet roofs darker and a little glossy, never white (roof.dark; roof.sheen: soaked roughness; roof.spec: soaked specular). ground: soaked ground's [roughness, specular] (land3d.gd), winter snow lying patchy on what faces the sky (roof.snow: how much of the season's ground snow the roofs carry; the season's ground snow is terrain.gd's; was 1.6, round 12: whole white roofs over Kingsmere's square were much of its 7.7% blown pixels, realm/tools/still_probe.py). puddles: when wetter than from, puddles on the ground round the square (count, size: world units; rough: [water, mud] roughness) and mud on the roads near the town (mud: how many spots, spacing along the road, size), drawn only for towns within near of the camera, fading in and out with the wet. Never on laid stone (round 12: the dark blobs on Kingsmere's setts read as stray shadows; weather_fx.gd spots, realm/tools/puddle_probe.gd): puddles in the ring round the heart (ring: from, to), of tries candidates each those wholly off the paving on a dirt road or in its gutter (within gutter of the paving's edge), lowest first; drawn as wet gloss: water, the sheen's colour and strength over the ground (was a flat 0.09 dark at 0.75), rough[0] the water's roughness (was 0.35; 0.08 blew out white in batch 9); mud only on dirt roads, never within mud_clear of the paving. leaves: snow on the trees' leaves in a snowy season (snow_leaf.gdshader, terrain.gd: cut by the leaf's own texture, on what faces the sky; cover: how white the snowiest leaf). plants: under snow, the share of the low plants buried outright (grass; flowers and clover: 1.0, all gone), the rest sinking low and straw-brown (plant_wind.gdshader, by the global snow). home: in rain or a storm this share of the townsfolk who would be out go home instead (npc_mind villager branch). fire: a wet town's fire spreads slower, gaps times (1 + wet x slow).
